note: Machine-readable side of docs/genome/LICENCES.md. Software licences and data/service terms are recorded separately. Nothing here is a legal conclusion. 'commercialPilot' is 'approved' only after a named person has reviewed the current terms; until then every item is 'not-approved', and tools running in commercial-pilot mode refuse to use it.

items.name: Ensembl REST API (gene, transcript, sequence)
items.supplies: Gene coordinates (GRCh38), canonical transcript and exons, coding and genomic sequence, release number.
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public REST service is called; no Ensembl code is bundled.
items.dataTerms: Read from the authoritative pages on 2026-10-27 (licence-terms run 40534185586 (2026-10-27); page hashes in docs/genome/terms-check.json). Ensembl disclaimer (served from jun2026.archive.ensembl.org after a redirect): 'Ensembl imposes no restrictions on access to, or use of, the data provided'; 'Ensembl data generated by members of the project are available without restriction'; Ensembl code is under Apache 2.0; the page also states that some data may be subject to third-party constraints. EMBL-EBI terms of use: EMBL-EBI 'places no additional restrictions on the use or redistribution of the data ... other than those provided by the original data owners'; 'The original data may be subject to rights claimed by third parties'; it 'expects attribution'; resource-specific terms prevail where they exist.
items.attribution: EMBL-EBI expects attribution 'in publications, services or products'; confirm the wording Ensembl asks for.
items.redistribution: Raw responses are redistributed in public/vision/snapshot/. Confirm this is permitted.
items.followUp: A named reviewer to confirm that no third-party-constrained Ensembl data is used, and that the redirect to the archive site does not change the terms; record the approval or restriction here.

items.name: UniProtKB REST API
items.supplies: Reviewed protein entry: sequence, function, tissue, catalytic activity, cross-references (HGNC, Ensembl, Reactome, PDB).
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public REST service is called.
items.dataTerms: Not verified. The licence and copyright pages were fetched on 2026-10-27 (licence-terms run 40534185586 (2026-10-27); page hashes in docs/genome/terms-check.json) but are rendered by JavaScript, so no text could be read; https://rest.uniprot.org/help/license is added for the next run. Secondary sources indicate CC BY 4.0.
items.attribution: If CC BY 4.0 is confirmed: attribution and a link to the licence are required.
items.redistribution: Raw responses are redistributed in public/vision/snapshot/. Confirm attribution is displayed alongside.
items.followUp: Confirm the licence and required attribution text; confirm cross-referenced content (e.g. Reactome names) carries no separate terms.

items.name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (API and model files)
items.supplies: Predicted structure coordinates and per-residue confidence (pLDDT).
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: AlphaFold code and model parameters are not used or bundled.
items.dataTerms: Not verified. The FAQ (JavaScript-rendered) and the licence disclaimer PDF were fetched on 2026-10-27 (licence-terms run 40534185586 (2026-10-27); page hashes in docs/genome/terms-check.json) but their text was not read; the next run extracts the PDF text. Secondary sources indicate CC BY 4.0 with EMBL-EBI terms. EMBL-EBI terms of use (read 2026-10-27, see ensembl-rest) apply to EMBL-EBI resources and defer to resource-specific terms. The API also links AlphaMissense annotation files, which are a separate component (see alphamissense) and are not used.
items.attribution: If CC BY 4.0 is confirmed: attribution and citation of the AlphaFold DB papers.
items.redistribution: A model file is redistributed in public/vision/snapshot/. Confirm this is permitted.
items.followUp: Read the licence disclaimer PDF and FAQ; keep model parameters and AlphaMissense out of scope unless separately reviewed.

items.name: NCBI ClinVar via E-utilities (esearch, esummary)
items.version: No release number in the response; snapshot retrieved 2026-10-20
items.supplies: Submitted variant records for a gene: HGVS, classification, review status, conditions, GRCh38 location.
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public E-utilities service is called.
items.dataTerms: NCBI policies page read on 2026-10-27 (licence-terms run 40534185586 (2026-10-27); page hashes in docs/genome/terms-check.json): information created by or for the US government is public domain, and NLM asks to be acknowledged; the site 'contains resources which incorporate material contributed or licensed by individuals, companies, or organizations that may be protected by U.S. and foreign copyright laws'; for molecular databases 'NCBI itself places no restrictions on the use' (the log line was truncated after this point); and 'NCBI's Disclaimer and Copyright notice must be evident to users of your service.' The E-utilities guidelines and ClinVar 'maintenance and use' pages were fetched but yielded no readable licence text.
items.attribution: NLM requests acknowledgment; NCBI's disclaimer and copyright notice must be evident to users of a service built on it.
items.redistribution: Raw esummary batches are redistributed in public/vision/snapshot/. Needs legal review because of submitter content.
items.followUp: Legal review of reuse and redistribution of submitter content; display NCBI's disclaimer and copyright notice wherever ClinVar data is shown; confirm E-utilities rate limits and the tool/email parameters.

items.name: HGNC REST service (genenames.org)
items.version: Recorded per capture (response timestamp); not yet captured
items.supplies: Authoritative approved gene symbol and HGNC ID, with Ensembl and UniProt cross-references, used to validate the gene registry.
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public REST service is called.
items.dataTerms: HGNC licence page read on 2026-10-27 (licence-terms run 40534185586 (2026-10-27); page hashes in docs/genome/terms-check.json): 'all data is released under the Creative Commons Public Domain (CC0) License. This means that any form of reuse of the content is permitted.' Attribution is not mandatory but recommended. REST usage limits not yet read.
items.attribution: Not mandatory under CC0; HGNC recommends citing its resource.
items.redistribution: The HGNC response is saved in each gene's snapshot.
items.followUp: Named reviewer sign-off; read the REST help page for rate limits.

items.name: RCSB PDB file service
items.version: Per entry; RPE65 has no experimental entry
items.supplies: Experimental structure coordinates, when UniProt cross-references one (Vision structure stage).
items.dataTerms: RCSB usage policy read on 2026-10-27 (licence-terms run 40534185586 (2026-10-27); page hashes in docs/genome/terms-check.json): 'data files contained in the PDB archive are available under the CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication'; 'All data provided by RCSB PDB programmatic APIs are available under the same license.' Site articles and text are copyrighted.
items.attribution: Encouraged, not required: the original authors of the structure and RCSB PDB.
items.redistribution: Not redistributed: fetched live by the browser only.
